description.p: FyClip is a desktop clipboard manager for text, images, HTML, and files, built with Go and Fyne.

Features include searchable clipboard history, pinned items, automatic categories, reusable snippets, encrypted local storage, password-protected backups, system tray integration, pause capture, autostart, and GitHub-based auto-updates.
The AppImage bundles its runtime dependencies and runs on most Linux distributions without installation.
Encrypted clipboard history, password-protected backups, auto-updates with SHA-256 digest verification, and image decompression bomb prevention.
